name: Lucy

tierList.prydwen: T1 Tower of Adversity, T2 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Pistols DPS from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab. Builds TCP -> Root Access to access an enhanced Heavy Attack chain (Dual/Multi-threading), then unleashes a unique freeze-frame Ultimate letting the player pick up to 7 'Spoofing Program' debuffs/damage effects. Uses the 'Hack' mechanic, a Tune Rupture variant exclusive to the collab characters.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Locked Thread (4 hits) / Thread Shredding in Algorithm Compaction.
skills.resonanceSkill: Payload -> Pulse Interference (builds TCP/Digital Handshake); at 100 TCP or in Algorithm Compaction becomes Deadlock (enters Algorithm Compaction, +65% Spectro DMG Bonus for 8s).
skills.forte: Depths of Blackwall - governs TCP (max 100), Root Access (max 100), and SQL stack management feeding Multi-threading's 270% DMG bonus.
skills.liberation: Netrunner (or Old Net Deep Dive variant post-Multi-threading) - freezes enemies, lets player select up to 7 Spoofing Programs (damage/debuffs) from a starting 24 RAM, ends with Override AoE hit.
skills.intro: Outdated Hallucination - Spectro hit, grants team wallhack vision (Involuntary Sharing), extra Rebecca synergy.
skills.outro: Countermeasure Program - 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplify to next character + team-wide Hack-Shifting/damage-reduction utility for 25s.

echoSet: Shadow of Shattered Dreams (100%, best - 1-piece + Adam Smasher, combined with Rite of Gilded Revelation/Pact of Neonlight Leap/Eternal Radiance/Celestial Light recommended, or Endless Resonance/Reel of Spliced Memories, or Moonlit Clouds/Empyrean Anthem/Tidebreaking Courage)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Rebecca is Lucy's only real partner - their kits reference each other directly; Mornye emphasizes Hack damage via Off-Tune Buildup Rate, Shorekeeper is a close second (better in Whimpering Wastes).

rotation: Opener: Ultimate (first 5 Programs, swap). Loop: Intro -> Skill: Payload -> Pulse Interference -> Basic 2,3,4 (cancel via Skill) -> Skill: Deadlock -> Thread 1-4 -> Heavy: Dual-threading -> Multi-threading (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate (first 5 Programs) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: accessible (free best-in-slot buffer in Rebecca, works fine with generalist Supports) but has a noticeably lower damage ceiling than other modern releases (roughly late-2.x-tier), fairly Signature-weapon dependent, and is a one-off collab character unlikely to rerun - grab now or likely miss out.
